name: Food and cooking (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 30 questions on food and cooking, written by Claude. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-03, from its own knowledge: no API call and no source document. NOT checked against a source.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.

items.question: What is the main ingredient in guacamole?
items.explain: Guacamole is made by mashing ripe avocados.

items.question: Raisins are made by drying which fruit?
items.explain: A raisin is a dried grape.

items.question: What is tofu made from?
items.explain: Tofu is made from soy milk, which comes from soybeans.

items.question: Which country is pizza from?
items.explain: Pizza as we know it comes from Naples, in Italy.

items.question: Beaten eggs cooked flat in a pan and folded over make what?
items.explain: An omelet is beaten eggs cooked in a pan, often folded around a filling.

items.question: Popcorn is made from which grain?
items.explain: Popcorn is a kind of corn whose kernels burst open when heated.

items.question: What is the main ingredient in hummus?
items.explain: Hummus is mashed chickpeas, often with sesame paste, lemon and garlic.

items.question: A dill pickle is made from which vegetable?
items.explain: Dill pickles are cucumbers soaked in brine with dill.

items.question: What is the yellow part of an egg called?
items.explain: The yolk is the yellow middle; the white surrounds it.

items.question: Which red spice, made from dried peppers, is often sprinkled on deviled eggs?
items.explain: Paprika is ground dried red peppers.

items.question: Marzipan is made mostly from which nut?
items.explain: Marzipan is a sweet paste of ground almonds and sugar.

items.question: What kind of food is cheddar?
items.explain: Cheddar is a cheese, named after a village in England.

items.question: Which fruit has its seeds on the outside?
items.explain: The little specks on the outside of a strawberry are its seeds.

items.question: Butter is made by churning what?
items.explain: Churning cream long enough turns it into butter.

items.question: Which grain is used to make sushi?
items.explain: Sushi is made with sticky rice seasoned with vinegar.

items.question: Which vegetable can make your eyes water when you cut it?
items.explain: Cutting an onion lets out a gas that stings the eyes.

items.question: Which kitchen tool do you use to flip pancakes?
items.explain: A flat spatula slides under a pancake to turn it over.

items.question: French fries are made from which vegetable?
items.explain: French fries are strips of potato fried in oil.

items.question: Prunes are made by drying which fruit?
items.explain: A prune is a dried plum.

items.question: Spaghetti is a kind of what?
items.explain: Spaghetti is long, thin pasta.

items.question: Which country is famous for tacos?
items.explain: Tacos come from Mexico.

items.question: What is the hard outside of a loaf of bread called?
items.explain: The crust is the outside; the soft inside is called the crumb.

items.question: What is the main ingredient in most bread?
items.explain: Bread is mostly flour mixed with water and yeast.

items.question: Coleslaw is made mostly from which vegetable?
items.explain: Coleslaw is shredded cabbage in a dressing.

items.question: Ketchup is made mainly from what?
items.explain: Ketchup is cooked tomatoes with vinegar, sugar and spices.

items.question: How many teaspoons make one tablespoon?
items.explain: Three teaspoons equal one tablespoon.

items.question: Which herb is the main ingredient in pesto?
items.explain: Classic pesto is basil ground with pine nuts, cheese, garlic and olive oil.

items.question: Which drink is made from roasted beans?
items.explain: Coffee is brewed from roasted, ground coffee beans.

items.question: A croissant is shaped like what?
items.explain: Croissant is the French word for crescent.

items.question: Which bird is usually the centerpiece of an American Thanksgiving dinner?
items.explain: Roast turkey is the traditional Thanksgiving main dish.
